enriched_activities.activity: Working the overnight shift at the aged-care residence: checking on residents, assisting with repositioning and personal care, preparing night drinks, and writing up detailed overnight observation notes
enriched_activities.desc: Clock in at the aged-care residence. Pick up the shift handover clipboard. Walk to Room 1. Open the door. Look at the resident. Walk to the bedside. Place a hand on the resident's shoulder. Ask 'Are you comfortable?' Write the time on the observation sheet. Walk to the next room. Open the door. Check the resident's position. Grip the slide sheet. Turn the resident onto their side. Adjust the pillow. Pull the blanket up. Walk to the kitchenette. Fill the kettle. Boil the water. Pour hot water into three cups. Stir in milk. Carry the tray to the corridor. Hand a cup to the resident in Room 3. Return the tray to the kitchenette. Rinse the cups. Sit at the nurse's station. Open the observation log. Write entries for each room. Check the clock. Walk the corridor round again. Assist a resident to the bathroom. Wash hands. Record the time. Write the final overnight notes. Sign the handover sheet.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the aged-care facility by train and bus, reading the shift handover notes on his phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the aged-care facility. Pull the staff door closed. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Open the handover notes file. Scroll down the screen. Look up at the approaching bus. Step onto the bus. Tap the travel card on the reader. Sit in a window seat. Read the handover notes again. Scroll to the medication section. Zoom in on the screen. Look up at the stop name. Stand up. Pull the stop cord. Step off the bus. Walk to the train station. Tap the card at the gate. Walk to the platform. Stand behind the yellow line. Board the train. Sit down. Re-read the notes on the phone. Lock the screen. Put the phone in the pocket. Stand up at the station. Exit the gate. Walk the last block home. Unlock the front door. Step inside. Close the door. Slide the deadbolt.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and quietly eating a light breakfast of toast and fruit with a pot of tea after the night shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the fridge. Take out the bread and the milk. Close the fridge. Place the bread on the bench. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate. Place the plate on the bench. Take two slices of bread from the bag. Put the slices on the plate. Open the cutlery drawer. Take out a knife. Open the jar of fruit spread. Spread it on the bread. Close the jar. Open the fridge. Take out an apple. Close the fridge. Rinse the apple under the tap. Cut the apple into quarters on the board. Fill the kettle at the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the switch. Open the cupboard. Take out a teapot. Put a tea bag in the teapot. Pour the boiled water into the teapot. Set the teapot on the table. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down. Eat the toast. Eat the apple quarters. Pour tea into a mug. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse them. Place them in the dish rack. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Quick shower and change into clean sleep clothes, hanging the work uniform to air
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Pull off the work shirt. Unbutton the trousers. Step out of the trousers. Drop the uniform into the laundry basket. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the temperature. Step into the shower. Wash the body with soap. Rinse off. Turn off the tap. Step out onto the mat. Take the towel from the rail. Dry the body. Dry the hair. Wrap the towel around the waist. Walk to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe. Take out the sleep shirt and sleep shorts. Put them on. Pick up the work uniform from the basket. Walk back to the bathroom. Hang the uniform on the hook by the window. Open the window slightly. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk to Bedroom 1. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the door closed and the fan on for white noise and quiet after the night shift
enriched_activities.desc: Close the bedroom door. Press the door handle down to check the latch. Walk to the window. Pull the curtain closed. Turn on the desk fan. Press the speed button to low. Walk to the bed. Pull back the quilt. Lie down on the bed. Pull the quilt over the body. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Close the eyes. Remain lying still. Turn onto the back. Adjust the pillow again. Remain lying still. Turn onto the right side. Remain lying still. At 14:25 open the eyes. Push the quilt back. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor. Stand up. Press the fan button to off. Walk to the door. Open the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing his face and showering, and getting dressed for the rest of the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup water in the hands. Splash water on the face. Take the face wash from the shelf. Squeeze a small amount onto the palm. Rub it over the face. Rinse the face under the tap. Turn off the tap. Take the towel from the rail. Wipe the face dry. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the temperature. Step into the shower. Wash the body and hair. Rinse off. Turn off the tap. Step out onto the mat. Dry the body with the towel. Walk to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe. Take out a t-shirt, trousers and socks. Put them on. Walk back to the bathroom. Comb the hair in front of the mirror. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk to the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a late flexitarian lunch of reheated rice, lentils and vegetables with a mug of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the fridge. Take out the container of rice, lentils and vegetables. Close the fridge. Open the microwave door. Place the container inside. Close the door. Press the reheat button. Press start. Wait at the bench. Open the cupboard. Take out a bowl and a plate. Set them on the bench. Take a fork from the cutlery drawer. The microwave beeps. Open the microwave door. Take out the container. Tip the contents into the bowl. Carry the bowl to the table. Sit down at the table. Eat the rice and lentils with the fork. Fill the kettle at the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the switch. Take a mug from the cupboard. Drop a tea bag into the mug. Pour the boiled water into the mug. Stir with the fork. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the bowl and mug to the sink. Rinse them. Place them in the dish rack. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying for his Master of Social Work at his desk: reading set texts, annotating lecture slides and drafting an assignment on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull the chair out from the desk. Sit down at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch. Open the laptop lid. Type the password. Open the lecture slides file. Open the set text PDF next to it. Pick up the highlighter pen. Mark two lines in the PDF. Put the highlighter down. Pick up the notebook. Write three notes in the margin. Put the notebook down. Scroll down the slides. Read the next section. Type two sentences into the assignment document. Scroll up. Re-read the paragraph. Highlight a sentence with the cursor. Press delete. Type a revised sentence. Open the referencing guide in a browser tab. Copy a citation. Paste it into the reference list. Check the word count at the bottom of the screen. Save the file with Ctrl+S. Read the next chapter section. Write two more notes. Stretch both arms above the head. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Fill a glass of water. Walk back. Sit down. Drink the water. Continue typing for the remaining time. Save the file again.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing written admin: updating his weekly budget, checking the rent and bill figures, and drafting written notes and reminders on his phone
enriched_activities.desc: Open the budget spreadsheet on the laptop. Click the income cell. Type the fortnightly pay figure. Click the rent cell. Type the rent amount. Open the browser. Log into the bank account. Read the balance on screen. Look at the electricity bill figure. Type it into the spreadsheet. Type the phone bill figure. Type the groceries figure. Check the total cell. Compare it with the income cell. Scroll up to the savings row. Type a savings amount. Save the spreadsheet. Pick up the phone. Open the notes app. Type 'Pay rent Friday'. Type 'Submit assignment draft Monday'. Type 'Book shift swap'. Type 'Buy rice and lentils'. Scroll through the note list. Close the notes app. Put the phone down on the desk. Close the spreadsheet. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a flexitarian dinner in weekly rotation: steaming rice in the rice cooker and stir-frying tofu and vegetables on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the cupboard. Take out the rice bag. Open the rice bag. Pour two cups of rice into the rice cooker inner pot. Carry the pot to the sink. Rinse the rice under the tap twice. Add water to the marked line. Place the pot back in the rice cooker. Close the lid. Press the cook button. Open the fridge. Take out the tofu block, the broccoli, the carrot and the capsicum. Close the fridge. Place the tofu on the board. Press the tofu with a paper towel. Cut the tofu into cubes with the knife. Scrape the cubes into a bowl. Cut the broccoli into florets. Peel the carrot. Slice the carrot. Cut the capsicum into strips. Place the wok on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Press the heat setting. Pour oil into the wok. Add the tofu cubes. Stir with the spatula. Add the carrot and capsicum. Stir again. Add the broccoli. Pour soy sauce over the vegetables. Stir for two minutes. Press the power button to off. Take a plate from the cupboard. Spoon the stir-fry onto the plate. Open the rice cooker lid. Spoon rice into a bowl. Close the rice cooker lid. Unplug nothing else.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the kitchen table with a cup of tea, following his usual no-alcohol routine
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the plate and the rice bowl to the kitchen table. Set them down. Pull the chair out. Sit down. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice with the fork. Eat the tofu cubes. Eat the broccoli florets. Take a second forkful of capsicum. Drink water from the glass. Stand up. Carry the empty plate and bowl to the bench. Fill the kettle at the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the switch. Take a mug from the cupboard. Drop a tea bag into the mug. Pour the boiled water into the mug. Carry the mug back to the table. Sit down. Stir the tea with a spoon. Drink the tea. Set the mug down. Pick up the phone. Open the roster app. Scroll the shifts list. Close the app. Put the phone down. Stand up. Carry the mug to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing the dishes, wiping the benches and returning shared kitchen items to their labelled places
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Add dish soap to the sponge. Wash the plate under the tap. Wash the bowl. Wash the mug. Wash the fork and the knife. Rinse each item under the tap. Place the plate in the dish rack. Place the bowl upside down in the dish rack. Place the mug on the rack. Place the cutlery in the cutlery holder. Wipe the board with the sponge. Rinse the board. Stand the board against the wall. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the kitchen table. Wipe the bench around the sink. Wipe the induction cooker surface. Pick up the tofu container. Put it back in the fridge. Close the fridge door. Put the rice bag back in the cupboard. Close the cupboard door. Put the spatula in the labelled drawer. Wipe the cloth over the sink edge. Hang the cloth on the rail. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing his written shift roster and study deadlines, updating his planner and setting phone alarms and reminders for the next few days
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch. Open the paper planner on the desk. Pick up the pen. Read the printed shift roster sheet. Write 'Overnight shift' in Tuesday's box. Write 'Overnight shift' in Thursday's box. Turn the page. Write 'Assignment draft due' in Wednesday's box. Write 'Seminar 10:00' in Friday's box. Put the pen down. Pick up the phone. Open the alarm app. Set an alarm for 21:00 tomorrow. Set an alarm for 20:30 Thursday. Set a reminder labelled 'Submit assignment'. Set a reminder labelled 'Confirm shift swap'. Set a reminder labelled 'Pay rent'. Check the alarm list. Close the app. Put the phone on the desk. Pick up the pen again. Tick the completed task boxes in the planner. Close the planner. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Press the desk lamp switch to off. Walk to the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet leisure at home: reading a book, drinking tea and looking at the photo of his family dog in China
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on the bed. Turn on the bedside light. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Open it at the bookmark. Read two pages. Turn the page. Read the next page. Close the book on the bookmark. Put the book on the bedside table. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Fill the kettle at the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the switch. Take a mug from the cupboard. Drop a tea bag into the mug. Pour the boiled water into the mug. Carry the mug back to Bedroom 1. Sit on the bed. Drink the tea. Pick up the phone. Open the photo album. Select the photo of the family dog in China. Zoom in on the photo. Look at the screen. Swipe to the next photo. Swipe back. Close the album. Put the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the book again. Open it. Read three pages. Close the book. Put it down. Turn off the bedside light. Turn on the fan. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening shower, dental care and night-time wind-down routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the temperature. Take off the t-shirt and trousers. Step into the shower. Wet the hair. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub it into the hair. Rinse the hair. Wash the body with soap. Rinse off. Turn off the tap. Step out onto the mat. Take the towel from the rail. Dry the body. Dry the hair. Take the toothbrush from the holder. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush the teeth. Spit into the basin. Rinse the mouth with water. Rinse the brush. Put the brush back in the holder. Wipe the face with the towel. Put on the sleep shirt and sleep shorts. Hang the used towel on the rail. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom. Turn off the corridor light.

enriched_activities.activity: Laying out clean clothes for tomorrow, setting his morning alarms and reminders, then reading quietly in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe. Take out a clean shirt. Fold the shirt. Lay it on the chair. Take out a pair of trousers. Fold the trousers. Lay them on the chair. Take out a pair of socks. Place them on the chair. Take out the work uniform. Lay it on the chair. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Open the alarm app. Set an alarm for 06:15. Set a second alarm for 06:25. Set a reminder labelled 'Pack lunch'. Check the alarm list. Close the app. Plug the phone into the charger. Put the phone on the bedside table. Turn on the bedside light. Pick up the book. Open it at the bookmark. Read four pages. Turn the page. Read two more pages. Close the book. Put it on the bedside table. Turn off the bedside light. Pull back the quilt. Lie down. Pull the quilt over the body. Close the eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in a quiet, dark room, with the fan on low
enriched_activities.desc: Lie still in the bed. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow. Remain lying still. Turn onto the back. Pull the quilt to the shoulders. Remain lying still. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow again. Remain lying still. Breathe steadily with eyes closed. Remain lying still. Shift the legs under the quilt. Remain lying still. Turn onto the back again. Remain lying still. Keep the fan running at low speed throughout. Remain lying still until 24:00.
